V. FUTHARK KOMPONENSEK SPECIFIKÁCIÓJA

C. GPU VECTOR OPERATIONS

Struktúra:
src/vector_engine/

EMBEDDING_SEARCH.FUT:
- Type definitions:
  - type embedding = [1024]f32
  - type doc_id = i64
- cosine_similarity [n] (a: [n]f32) (b: [n]f32) : f32
  - Dot product: map2 (*) a b |> reduce (+) 0f32
  - L2 norms: sqrt of sum of squares
  - Division: dot / (norm_a * norm_b)
- batch_cosine [m][n] (query: [n]f32) (docs: [m][n]f32) : [m]f32
  - Fully parallel map over docs
  - GPU-optimized: 1 thread per document
- top_k [m] (k: i64) (scores: [m]f32) (doc_ids: [m]doc_id) : ([k]doc_id, [k]f32)
  - Radix sort on scores (descending)
  - Take first k elements
  - Return zipped (ids, scores)
- entry search: main search function
  - Input: query embedding, document embeddings (100 billion capacity), doc_ids, k
  - Process: batch similarity → top-k selection
  - Output: k document IDs + scores
- entry batch_search: multiple queries parallel
  - Input: [q] queries
  - Parallel map: each query independently processed
  - Output: [q]([k]results)

IVF (INVERTED FILE) SEARCH:
- entry ivf_search:
  - Centroids: [c][n]f32 (pl. 262,144 clusters)
  - Partitions: [c][]doc_id (cluster assignments)
  - nprobe parameter (default: 128 clusters search)
  - Step 1: Query → top nprobe nearest centroids (batch_cosine)
  - Step 2: Gather candidate documents from those clusters
  - Step 3: Compute exact similarities on candidates
  - Step 4: top_k final results
  - Optimization: ~1000x speedup vs exhaustive search

PRODUCT QUANTIZATION:
- Embedding compression: 1024 float32 (4KB) → 64 bytes (64x compression)
- Subdivision: 1024 dims → 64 subvectors × 16 dims
- Codebooks: 64 × 256 × 16 (64 subspaces, 256 centroids each)
- entry pq_encode: embedding → 64 byte codes
- entry pq_search: approximate search on compressed embeddings
- Accuracy tradeoff: ~95% recall @ k=100 with 64-byte codes

HNSW-INSPIRED HIERARCHICAL SEARCH:
- entry hierarchical_search:
  - Graph structure: [][]doc_id (adjacency lists)
  - Entry point: highest degree node
  - Greedy search: follow nearest neighbors
  - Layer-wise refinement (coarse → fine)
  - Early stopping: no improvement in 10 iterations

QUANTIZATION:
- entry quantize_embeddings: float32 → float16 (2x memory savings)
- entry dequantize_embeddings: float16 → float32
- Precision loss: negligible for similarity search (<0.1% accuracy drop)

SIMILARITY.FUT:
- euclidean [n]: L2 distance
- manhattan [n]: L1 distance
- dot_product [n]: unnormalized similarity
- angular_distance [n]: arccos(cosine) / π
- jaccard [n]: intersection over union (sparse vectors)
- entry pairwise_cosine [n][m][d]: N×M similarity matrix
  - Fully parallel: map over queries × map over docs
  - Output: [n][m]f32 matrix
- entry build_knn_graph [m][n]: k-nearest neighbor graph construction
  - Input: [m] embeddings
  - Compute pairwise similarities (m×m matrix)
  - For each node: select k nearest (exclude self)
  - Output: [m][k]i64 adjacency lists

INDEX_BUILDER.FUT:
- K-means clustering:
  - entry kmeans [m][n]: iterative centroid refinement
  - K-means++ initialization (smart seeding)
  - Assignment step: parallel argmin distances
  - Update step: parallel mean computation per cluster
  - Convergence: max_iter (50) or tolerance (0.001)
  - GPU optimization: entire dataset in VRAM (1440GB supports 360M documents @ 1024 dims)
- entry assign_to_clusters: parallel cluster assignment
- entry build_ivf_index: partition documents by cluster
  - Output: [k][]doc_id (inverted lists per cluster)
  - Balance checking: warn if cluster size variance >3x mean

RERANKER.FUT:
- Transformer attention implementation:
  - Single-head attention: Q, K, V matrices
  - Scaled dot-product: QK^T / sqrt(d_k)
  - Softmax normalization
  - Weighted sum: Attention(Q, K, V) = softmax(QK^T / sqrt(d_k)) V
- Multi-head attention:
  - Parallel heads (8 or 16)
  - Concatenation + linear projection
  - Residual connection
- entry rerank_transformer:
  - Input: query-document pairs (tokenized, embedded)
  - Process: multi-layer Transformer encoder
  - Output: relevance scores [n]f32
  - Use case: Top-100 from vector search → re-rank to Top-10

BATCH_ENCODER.FUT:
- entry pad_sequences: variable length → fixed length (zero-padding)
- entry create_attention_masks: mask padding tokens (0 = pad, 1 = real)
- entry positional_encoding: sinusoidal position embeddings
  - PE(pos, 2i) = sin(pos / 10000^(2i/d))
  - PE(pos, 2i+1) = cos(pos / 10000^(2i/d))
- entry batch_normalize: layer normalization

PAGERANK.BEND:
- Type definitions:
  - type Graph = Map U32 [U32]  (adjacency lists)
  - type Scores = Map U32 F32
- def pagerank(graph, num_iters, damping):
  - Initialize: uniform scores (1/N per node)
  - Iteration loop (20-30 iterations):
    - For each node: sum incoming contributions
    - Contribution: score[source] / outdegree[source]
    - Update: (1-damping)/N + damping * sum_contrib
  - HVM2 parallel: automatic GPU parallelization of map operations
  - Return: final scores
- def personalized_pagerank(graph, seed_nodes, teleport_prob, num_iters):
  - Teleport only to seed nodes (topic-sensitive ranking)
  - Use case: domain authority within specific topics

HITS ALGORITHM:
- def hits(graph, num_iters):
  - Dual scores: hubs[node], authorities[node]
  - Iteration:
    - Authority update: sum of hub scores of in-neighbors
    - Hub update: sum of authority scores of out-neighbors
    - Normalization: L2 norm = 1
  - Return: (hubs_map, authorities_map)
  - Use case: identify authoritative sources (high authority) and good directories (high hub)

PARALLEL BFS:
- def parallel_bfs(graph, start):
  - Level-synchronous BFS
  - Frontier expansion: fully parallel over current frontier
  - Distance tracking: Map U32 U32
  - Optimization: bitmap frontier for dense graphs

CONNECTED COMPONENTS:
- def connected_components(graph):
  - Parallel union-find algorithm
  - Iterative edge contraction
  - Path compression for efficiency
  - Output: Map node → component_id

LINK_ANALYSIS.BEND:
- SimRank similarity:
  - def simrank(graph, num_iters, decay):
    - Structural similarity: nodes are similar if neighbors are similar
    - Recursive formula: sim(a,b) = decay * avg(sim(I(a), I(b)))
    - Output: [n][n] similarity matrix
- TrustRank:
  - def trustrank(graph, seeds, num_iters, damping):
    - Anti-spam ranking
    - Trusted seeds: manually verified quality sites
    - Propagate trust via links
- Katz centrality:
  - def katz_centrality(adjacency, alpha, beta):
    - Considers all paths (weighted by length)
    - Formula: (I - alpha*A^T)^(-1) * beta * 1
    - Power series approximation (20 terms)
- Betweenness centrality:
  - def betweenness_centrality(graph):
    - Nodes on many shortest paths = high betweenness
    - Parallel all-pairs shortest paths (Floyd-Warshall vagy parallel BFS from all nodes)
    - Use case: identify critical bridge nodes

  - Reduce memory footprint (fit larger batches)

LOSS_KERNELS.SPI:
- Contrastive loss CUDA kernel:
  - Input: query embeddings [batch, dim], doc embeddings [batch * (1+negatives), dim]
  - Similarity matrix: matmul + temperature division
  - Softmax: exp normalization (numerically stable)
  - Cross-entropy: -log(softmax[correct_idx])
  - Reduction: sum across batch
- InfoNCE loss variant:
  - Positive pairs: (query, positive_doc)
  - Negatives: all other docs in batch
  - Maximize agreement with positives, minimize with negatives
- Hard negative mining kernel:
  - Sort negatives by similarity (highest = hardest)
  - Weight loss: higher weight for hard negatives
  - Gradient clipping per sample
- Triplet loss (alternative):
  - Anchor, positive, negative triplets
  - Margin-based loss: max(0, d(a,p) - d(a,n) + margin)

OPTIMIZER.SPI:
- AdamW optimizer CUDA kernel:
  - Parameters: weights, gradients, momentum1, momentum2, learning_rate, weight_decay
  - Update rule:
    - momentum1 = beta1 * momentum1 + (1-beta1) * grad
    - momentum2 = beta2 * momentum2 + (1-beta2) * grad^2
    - weight = weight - lr * momentum1 / (sqrt(momentum2) + eps) - lr * wd * weight
  - Fused kernel: single pass (no intermediate memory writes)
  - Bias correction: adjust momentum estimates for first iterations
- Learning rate scheduling:
  - Warmup: linear ramp 0 → peak_lr (first 10k steps)
  - Cosine decay: cos((step - warmup) / total_steps * π/2) * peak_lr
  - Cooldown: linear decay to min_lr (last 5k steps)
- Gradient clipping:
  - Global norm clipping: scale all gradients if norm > threshold
  - Per-parameter clipping: clip each grad individually
  - CUDA kernel: parallel norm computation (reduction)

- NCCL wrapper kernels:
  - AllReduce: sum gradients across 8 GPUs
  - Broadcast: distribute updated weights
  - Ring algorithm: efficient for large tensors
- Gradient bucketing:
  - Group small tensors into buckets (reduce communication overhead)
  - Overlap computation with communication (gradient accumulation while AllReduce in progress)
- Mixed precision sync:
  - FP16 communication (2x bandwidth savings)
  - FP32 accumulation (accuracy)
- Checkpoint saving kernel:
  - Efficient GPU → CPU transfer

  - POST /search

  - Process:
    - Load index from Volume (persistent storage)
    - Call Futhark function: ivf_search
    - Fetch document metadata from PostgreSQL
    - Format results
  - Output JSON: {"doc_ids": [...], "scores": [...], "documents": [{title, url, snippet}]}
- Index loading optimization:
  - Mmap index file (zero-copy load)
  - Shard indices across 8 GPUs (each GPU: ~12.5 billion docs)
  - Parallel search: query all 8 GPUs simultaneously
  - Merge results: top-k from each GPU → final top-k

EMBEDDING_ENCODE FUNCTION:
- GPU spec: "B200:4" (autoscale 0-4 based on load)
- Model loading:
  - Transformer model: DeBERTa-v3 vagy custom trained
  - Checkpoint: Modal Volume mount (/checkpoints/)
  - DeepSpeed ZeRO-2 for multi-GPU (if 4 GPUs active)
- Batch encoding:
  - Input: {"texts": [array of strings], "max_length": 512}
  - Tokenization: call Terra binary (fast C++ tokenizer)
  - Encoding: forward pass through Transformer
  - Pooling: mean pooling over tokens (excluding padding)
  - Normalization: L2 normalize
  - Output: {"embeddings": [[1024 floats] × batch_size]}
- Throughput target: 10,000 documents/second across 4 GPUs

GRAPH_COMPUTE FUNCTION:
- GPU spec: "B200:8"
- Bend HVM2 runtime:
  - Compiled Bend binaries
  - CUDA backend for GPU parallelization
- Operations:
  - PageRank: input graph (adjacency lists), output scores
  - Community detection: Louvain method
  - Shortest paths: parallel BFS from multiple sources
- Input format: {"operation": "pagerank", "graph": {"nodes": [...], "edges": [...]}, "params": {...}}
- Output: {"results": {...}}

BATCH_INDEXER FUNCTION:
- Scheduled job: Modal Cron (daily 2AM UTC)
- GPU spec: "B200:8"
- Process:
  - Fetch newly crawled documents (PostgreSQL query: WHERE indexed=false)
  - Batch encode: call embedding encode function
  - Update FAISS index: add new vectors
  - Write updated index to Volume
  - Mark documents as indexed: UPDATE documents SET indexed=true
